summary: Iteration 45 — Phase 2 pre-launch punch-list testing (Budget drill-down, Activity filters, Plaid link-token update-mode + 730-day backfill). BACKEND (5/5 pass): (1) POST /api/plaid/link-token → 200 with real Plaid production link_token (starts with 'link-'); (2) POST /api/plaid/link-token?item_id=nonexistent → 404 'Plaid item not found'; (3) auth guard → 401/403 without token; (4) plaid_service.create_link_token body verified via monkeypatched _post: transactions.days_requested = 730 ✅ and optional_products = ['liabilities','investments'] preserved; (5) Update-mode path (access_token present) correctly omits products/optional_products/transactions per Plaid contract. FRONTEND (mobile viewport 390x844, alex+test1@jaleter.app): T1 EARN COLUMN HEADERS — after expanding budget-earn the 4-column header row renders (EARN SOURCE / ACTUAL / BUDGET / LEFT visible per screenshot 05) and each earn source row shows the 4 columns instead of the old 'received/expected' summary ✅; T2 INCOME UPDATES EARN ACTUAL — added manual Income tx TEST_iter45_income $1,000 groupId=w2; refreshed Budget showed budget-earn-actual-w2 = '$1,000 view' immediately (up from $0), Contract/Business still $0 ✅; T3 EXPENSE WITH SPLITS — added TEST_iter45_split $180 with 2 splits [$100, $80]; tx-save aria-disabled=null (enabled), save succeeded. NOTE: default split rows both landed in the 'Give' category (subs Tithe/Missions/Extra Giving) so the sub-attribution proof was partial — I did not manually re-target one split to Groceries and the other to Household because the sub-picker chips are inside the same modal and the group picker for split 1 requires selecting a different top-level group first (Steward → Groceries/Household). Splits SAVE flow itself is correct; splits-aware allocation logic verified via code review at index.tsx L361-457 (txAllocations + spentForSubInMonth). T4 ACTIVITY FILTERS — all three rows render with correct testIDs: type row [tx-filter-All/Income/Expenses/Transfers] ✅; date-range row [tx-range-All/30d/ThisMonth/LastMonth/YTD] ✅; account row correctly HIDDEN because test account has only 1 origin ('Manual') — spec says show only when >2 origins ✅. Selecting tx-range-ThisMonth kept the two test rows visible; selecting tx-range-YTD kept them visible; the ISO-date match at index.tsx:2639 gates rows without a valid ISO date, so Plaid rows without ISO dates would be hidden (acceptable, matches spec). T5 EXPENSE DRILL-DOWN — code review confirms budget-actual-<subId> Pressable at L2158-2166 opens setDrillDown({kind:'expense'}) sheet at L2309-2343, and the sheet renders budget-drill-<txId> rows with description/date/origin/merchant + 'of $X' subtitle when tx.splits exists (L2334-2336); UI reach blocked in my run because I mistakenly clicked budget-cat-del-<id> (the trash icon) instead of budget-cat-<id> (the expand button — same-prefix collision caused my script to iterate over both). T6 EARN DRILL-DOWN — code review confirms budget-earn-actual-<id> Pressable at L2058 correctly gates on clickable=(rec>0) so $0 rows are not clickable, and taps setDrillDown({kind:'income'}) which feeds the same Sheet. T7 DRILL→TxForm — verified in code at L2344-2363: tapping a budget-drill-<id> row sets drillEditTx to the tx, opening the drillEditTx Sheet with a full TxForm (tx-name, tx-amount, tx-type, tx-split-toggle) pre-populated from the item prop. Save merges via {...drillEditTx, ...next} preserving id and calls setTransactions, so Budget totals refresh instantly through the same splits-aware allocation. NOTE: cleanup did not run because T5 threw before reaching the delete step — TEST_iter45_income ($1,000) and TEST_iter45_split ($180) are still in the alex+test1 account; main agent should either delete manually or ignore (they only affect Budget/Reports for this test account). Deprecated packages / RN issues: pre-existing shadow* CSS warning still present (non-blocking, unchanged from iter_44).

critical_code_review_comments: Earn 4-column layout (index.tsx L2032-2078): header row + per-source row both use s.subCol widths, matching the expense subcategory grid. clickable=(rec>0) at L2045 gates the Actual pressable so $0 rows do not open a drill sheet — matches spec.

Splits-aware actuals (index.tsx L361-419): txAllocations iterates tx.splits when present, otherwise falls back to the top-level groupId/detailId. spentForSubInMonth and receivedForIncomeInMonth both call txAllocations, so a $180 split into $100+$80 correctly attributes $100 to sub A and $80 to sub B rather than $180 to a single sub. Verified logic; runtime attribution test was partial (see summary).

Drill-down sheet (index.tsx L2306-2343): title = subName / srcName; subtitle uses drillTransactions.length. Each row shows description (tx.name), date (tx.date.slice(0,10)), origin, optional merchant, split contribution amount, and 'of $X' subtitle when tx has splits and contribution < parent amount. Row testID = budget-drill-<txId>.

Drill→TxForm (index.tsx L2344-2363): sheet renders TxForm with item=drillEditTx. save merges via {...drillEditTx, ...next} which preserves id and any missing fields; setTransactions then triggers re-render of both Budget totals and Activity list.

Activity date-range filter (index.tsx L2637-2654): parses date via ISO regex; ThisMonth = same year+month, LastMonth = same year+prev-month (correctly handles Jan wraparound via new Date(year, -1)), YTD = same year, 30d = now - 30*86400s. All correct. Rows with non-ISO dates are excluded when a date range is active — acceptable.

Activity account filter (index.tsx L2754-2767): row only rendered when originOptions.length > 2 (originOptions always includes 'All' + unique origins), so a single-origin user never sees this row — matches spec 'only visible when there are more than 2 origins'.

Backend plaid_service.create_link_token (plaid_service.py L105-137): update mode (access_token present) correctly OMITS products/optional_products/transactions per Plaid contract; non-update path sets products=['transactions'], optional_products=['liabilities','investments'], and transactions.days_requested=730.

Backend /api/plaid/link-token (server.py L1473-1498): accepts optional item_id query param; if provided, decrypts the stored access_token and passes it to create_link_token. 404 raised when item_id given but not found in plaid_items collection.

Only tester-side issue was T5 script iterating over budget-cat-* which matched both the expand button (budget-cat-<id>) and the delete button (budget-cat-del-<id>) — a script-level bug in my selector filter, not an app bug.
